name: Waga Himegimi ni Eikan o
source:
The protagonist Shaon, who grew up in a remote area, was taught a technique called Tenken by his teacher. 

The teacher hopes that Shaon will pass on his abilities to his descendants.
When he is old enough, he needs to leave his home to find a bride.
How you live your life, whom will you marry? It all depends on your choice.
translation:
在边境长大的主角夏恩，从师父那里学会了一种名为“天眷”的能力。

师父希望他能将这份本领传授给子孙后代。
如今，他已到了适婚的年纪，需要离开家乡，寻找自己的新娘。
你将过上怎样的生活，与谁结婚？一切都由你的选择决定。
